title: Written on the Wall II Conjecture 2
statement: For every nontrivial finite connected simple graph G, the maximum number L_s(G) of leaves in a spanning tree satisfies L_s(G)≥2(l_avg(G)−1), where l_avg(G) is the average of α(G[N(v)]) over all vertices.

counterexample.description: A finite connected simple graph whose exact maximum number of spanning-tree leaves is smaller than twice its average neighborhood independence number minus two.
